**Finding submitted: missing (high severity).**

- **Gap:** The Agreement has a three-year term (§ 8.1), but Section 9 contains only cause-based exits — material breach (9.1), insolvency (9.2), and Vendor security/service-level/legal/IP failures (9.3). Section 8.2 only allows non-renewal on 180 days' notice, and § 27.3 is a force-majeure exit. Nothing gives us a convenience termination right, which is walk-away territory under T4C for a multi-year term.
- **Direction check:** Vendor has no convenience right either, so no Vendor-side deletion is needed — the fix is purely to add our exit right.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** New § 9.4 giving Customer convenience termination of the Agreement or any Order Form on 30 days' notice, without penalty, with refund of prepaid Fees for the post-termination period keyed to § 10.2, plus confirmation that Vendor has no in-term convenience right. Fallback of 60 days' notice offered in the comment.
